observations: Black professional stage lighting fixture with a circular lens and concentric rings.
A white circular trim surrounds the lens.
A control panel is visible on the top right of the fixture.
The fixture is mounted on a white stand.
A watermark 'CHUZZY ELECTRICAL' is overlaid on the image.
The background shows an office or workshop environment with a chair and red cabinets.

risks.risk: The internal LED driver or power supply may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video showing the light powered on and cycling through its color and movement modes.

risks.risk: The optical lens may be damaged, fogged, or have internal scratches.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the lens glass with the fixture powered off.

risks.risk: The moving head mechanism (gyroscopic motor) may be seized or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the fixture rotating and the beam sweeping across a surface.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the light powered on, cycling through all its functions, and moving.
Close-up photo of the lens glass to check for scratches or fogging.
Photo of the rear of the fixture showing the power input and connection ports.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a professional moving head light. It can be priced at its worst-case functional state (non-working) until proof of operation is provided.
